verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a registrable system-wide hotkey that brings iTerm2 to the foreground from any app and frame it as an always-available terminal like Visor/Guake/Yakuake (docs-2, docs-43). The GitHub README confirms a hotkey terminal that slides down from the top or any screen edge, even over fullscreen apps (gh-17). Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of the hotkey/dropdown window.
